examples.purpose: A rupee amount from ₹500 to ₹50,000 that snaps to ₹500 steps.
examples.jsx:
<Slider
  accessibilityLabel="Monthly SIP amount"
  minValue={500}
  maxValue={50000}
  step={500}
  defaultValue={5000}
  formatOptions={{ style: 'currency', currency: 'INR', maximumFractionDigits: 0 }}
  locale="en-IN"
  onChange={(value) => {}}
  modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }}
/>

from.quote: Values snap to ₹500 steps and read as rupees.

examples.purpose: A loan tenure whose format function also writes “1 year”.
examples.jsx:
<Slider
  accessibilityLabel="Loan tenure"
  minValue={1}
  maxValue={30}
  defaultValue={10}
  formatValue={(value) => (value === 1 ? '1 year' : `${value} years`)}
  modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }}
/>

props.name: value
props.description: Current value (controlled). Pair with `onChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value (uncontrolled). Defaults to `minValue`.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called continuously while the value changes (drag / keypress / track press).

props.name: onChangeEnd
props.description: Fires on release and on key presses; since 636f3f5 not when a key can't change the value. Ref methods do nothing while disabled. Declared: Called once when the interaction ends (drag release / keypress).

props.name: minValue
props.description: Minimum selectable value. Defaults to `0`. Default 0, from the component source.

props.name: maxValue
props.description: Maximum selectable value. Defaults to `100`. Default 100, from the component source.

props.name: step
props.description: Arrow keys move one step, Page Up and Down 10% of the range, Home and End to the ends; tapping anywhere on the 20 px row jumps the handle there. Declared: Snap increment. Defaults to `1`. Use a smaller value for finer control. Default 1, from the component source.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: 50% opacity, tabindex -1, no drag or key response; on the web it also sets aria-disabled (636f3f5). Declared: Disables interaction and dims the control. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: Formats the bubble and both end labels, like formatValue. Declared: `Intl.NumberFormat` options used to format the value bubble and the min/max labels (e.g. `{ style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' }`).

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP-47 locale used with `formatOptions`. Defaults to the runtime locale.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Also formats the end labels, so a function that appends a unit must handle the singular: a plain `${v} years` writes “1 years” on the minimum label. Declared: Full override for value formatting. Takes precedence over `formatOptions`. Receives the raw numeric value, returns the string to display.

props.name: renderTooltip
props.description: Renders fully custom value-bubble content. Takes precedence over `formatValue`.

props.name: alwaysShowTooltip
props.description: Either way the bubble sits 12 px above the 20 px handle row and takes no layout space, so content directly above the Slider is covered. Declared: When `true` (default, matches the Figma design) the value bubble is always visible. When `false` it behaves like a normal tooltip — hidden at rest and revealed only while the user interacts (dragging on touch, or hovering/dragging on web), then dismissed as soon as the finger lifts. Either way the bubble floats above the track and never occupies layout space, so it will overlap content above the slider — leave room for it. Default true, from the component source.

props.name: showLabels
props.description: Toggles the min/max labels below the track. Defaults to `true`. Default true, from the component source.

props.name: minLabel
props.description: Override for the left (min) label. Defaults to the formatted `minValue`.

props.name: maxLabel
props.description: Override for the right (max) label. Defaults to the formatted `maxValue`.

props.name: width
props.description: Slider width. Defaults to `'100%'` so it fills its parent. Default "100%", from the component source.

props.name: modes
props.description: Since 636f3f5, JFSThemeProvider's modes apply too, matching the modes prop. Declared: Design-token modes for theming.

props.name: style
props.description: Style override for the outer container.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Names the role=slider element, the only element carrying the name; it exposes aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and aria-valuetext, and aria-disabled when disabled. Declared: Accessibility label for screen readers.

props.name: testID
props.description: Test identifier for the slider.

props.name: disableTruncation
props.description: When `true`, disables text truncation: the trailing ellipsis (`…`) is never shown and any `numberOfLines` clamp is ignored, so the text wraps to as many lines as it needs even when horizontal space is tight.
